27 A continuous progressive water wave in a ripple tank passes through a gap in a barrier and
diffracts.
The width of the gap is greater than the wavelength of the wave.
Which change causes the wave to spread over a larger angle as it passes through the gap?
A
a small decrease in the wavelength of the wave
B
a small decrease in the width of the gap
C
a small increase in the frequency of the wave
D
a small increase in the height of the barrier

hints: Carefully read the question stem and identify the given physical quantities for 9702_s23_12_q27.
Apply the relevant physical formula or conservation principle connecting these quantities.
Calculate or deduce the final result and match with the correct option.
walkthrough: Examine the physical scenario described in the question.
Apply the foundational equations governing this topic to evaluate the options.
The correct deduction leads directly to option B.
